title: Task Runner buttons
description: Buttons shown in the Task Runner sidebar, in the order listed.

buttons.description: The buttons, in the order shown.

button.description: A button that runs a task from tasks.json (or a task provider), runs a shell command, or opens a group of more buttons.

group.description: Makes this a group: a folder of buttons. The name shown under its icon. Needs "buttons"; "label", "confirm" and the run keys do not apply.

buttons.description: Only for "group". The buttons inside it, which may be groups too.

task.description: Label of the task to run, as listed in Terminal > Run Task.

source.description: Only for "task". Tells same-named tasks apart: "Workspace" for tasks.json, or a provider such as "npm".

folder.description: Only for "task". Workspace folder name, in a multi-root workspace.

command.description:
Shell command to run. Variables such as ${workspaceFolder} are resolved by VS Code. In JSON a backslash starts an escape: write a Windows path as .\scripts\build.ps1 (doubled) or use forward slashes, because 	, 
, ,   and   silently become control characters.

cwd.description: Only for "command". Working directory; defaults to the workspace folder. Backslashes must be doubled, or use forward slashes.

shell.description: Only for "command". Shell executable to use instead of the default, e.g. "bash".

id.description: Stable identifier, unique in this file, groups' children included. Optional; derived from what the button runs.

label.description: Text under the icon. Defaults to the task label or the command.

icon.description: Codicon name (e.g. "tools", "beaker", "rocket"), a workspace-relative image ("./icons/build.svg" or ".png"), or an emoji. Defaults by task group; a group defaults to "folder".

tooltip.description: Hover text. Defaults to what the button will run.
